3. 手绘文化细节

* 当地街道路牌、装饰灯具和建筑装饰细节。

Can MiniMax H3 Make a Chinese-Style Vertical Drama? 🎬

I started watching these Asian short dramas made for phones ( vertical format, like TikTok) and got curious. Could I make one myself using MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI?

Well, here's Episode 1 of The Wrong Table!

My setup:
MiniMax H3 — 8 steps with Turbo LoRA
RTX 5090 — 24GB VRAM
64GB RAM
Restaurant background ambience added using ElevenLabs
9:16 vertical format

The whole episode took a little under 2 hours to put together. Each 12-second generation took approximately 23–24 minutes.

I also wanted to recreate that dramatic freeze-frame, white-flash ending you see in so many Asian short dramas. You know, where the camera flashes back and forth between two characters before freezing on someone's shocked expression!

I experimented with H3 and got an interesting result.

I've included the prompt below if anyone wants to try the effect themselves. Just use two reference images of the characters you want to flash back and forth between, and adjust the prompt to fit your scene.

Still experimenting, but it's been a fun little project!

Prompt for flash at end.

THE WRONG TABLE — EPISODE 1 — CLIFFHANGER FREEZE-FRAME ENDING

CRITICAL: NO ON-SCREEN TEXT OR SUBTITLES. No captions, names, titles, logos, or watermarks.

REFERENCE IMAGES:

<image 1> — CHEN YICHEN: Use the provided restaurant image of the male lead as the ONLY visual reference for the male character. Strictly preserve his original facial appearance, hairstyle, navy-blue suit jacket, light-blue shirt, calm expression with a slight smile, and the original restaurant background, lighting, and camera angle. Do not redesign the character.

<image 2> — SHEN RUOXI: Use the provided shocked close-up image of the female lead as the ONLY visual reference for the female character. Strictly preserve her original facial appearance, long hair, gold hoop earrings, dark-blue silk blouse, widened eyes, slightly parted lips, and the original background, lighting, and camera angle. Do not redesign the character.

integrated_multimodal_description: 9:16 vertical format, modern Chinese urban romantic short drama, cinematic photorealistic live-action visuals, classic Chinese short-drama suspenseful freeze-frame ending. The entire sequence uses ONLY the two original character images from <image 1> and <image 2>. Do not create new camera shots or change the characters' faces, expressions, clothing, compositions, or backgrounds. Create suspense through frozen images, rapid cuts, white flashes, soft misty light blooms, and fade-out effects. The character appearance order must strictly be: Shen Ruoxi → Chen Yichen → Shen Ruoxi.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, immediately show the shocked facial close-up of Shen Ruoxi from <image 2>. Her eyes are widened and her lips are slightly parted, preserving the exact shocked expression from the original image. The image freezes completely. No blinking, no head movement, and no lip movement. A soft, misty white glow gradually appears around the edges of the frame, followed by a rapid white flash at 00:00.850.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, immediately after the white flash, hard cut to the original restaurant image of Chen Yichen from <image 1>. Preserve his original seated posture, subtle smile, clothing, and background. The image remains completely frozen, creating a strong contrast with the female lead's shocked expression. Hold briefly, then introduce another rapid white flash.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.000, immediately after the flash, cut back to the original shocked close-up of Shen Ruoxi from <image 2>. The image instantly freezes, preserving her exact original facial expression and composition. Add a subtle, soft white misty glow around the edges, a hazy light bloom, and a brief ghosted afterimage overlay to create the suspenseful atmosphere of a classic Chinese short-drama cliffhanger ending. Her face must remain clearly visible at all times and must not be obscured by the white glow.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.000, continue holding the completely frozen close-up of Shen Ruoxi. The soft white glow briefly intensifies, then gradually diminishes. During the final half-second, smoothly fade the image to pure black. End at 00:04.000.

VISUAL CONTINUITY: Strictly preserve the characters' identities, original facial structures, hairstyles, clothing, natural skin textures, lighting, backgrounds, and camera compositions from the two reference images. All character images must remain completely motionless freeze-frames. Only editing transitions and subtle optical effects are permitted. Do not generate new actions, change facial expressions, animate lips, introduce additional characters, change locations, rotate the camera, zoom in, or zoom out. No subtitles, no text, no graphic titles, and no watermarks.

overall_soundscape: Begin with a short, deep cinematic suspense impact sound. Each rapid white flash is accompanied by a subtle, clean air-whoosh sound. During the final freeze-frame, maintain a brief lingering low-frequency suspense resonance that quickly disappears as the image fades out, ending in complete silence. No character dialogue, no voiceover, and no restaurant conversations.

non_diegetic_music: None. Use only brief suspense impact sound effects and white-flash transition sounds. No continuous background music.
